besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses, and 'daaraan gedink' reads as 'remembered/thought of it' rather than 'thought nothing of it'.
besluite.rede: The idiom 'iets daarvan dink' says exactly what the story means (nobody worried about the cough) and the comma is required; no fact moves.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma, and a flat 'en' where the two clauses plainly contrast.
besluite.rede: 'maar' states the contrast the paragraph is built on (the cold ended, the cough did not) without adding any fact.

besluite.fout: 'nou nagte lank wakker word' with a present-tense verb reads stiffly without 'al'.
besluite.rede: 'nou al nagte lank' is the natural Afrikaans for an ongoing duration; same symptom, same speaker.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: Plain punctuation fix required by AWS 2017.

besluite.fout: 'ver om die boom geloop' is a loose, unidiomatic way of saying he kept away.
besluite.rede: ''n wye draai om iets loop' is the fixed Afrikaans expression for avoiding something and keeps the same action.

besluite.fout: 'Sy het getel' has no object and reads vague; 'nou meer as twee weke' lacks the natural 'al'.
besluite.rede: 'die dae getel' only names what was already being counted and 'nou al' marks the duration so far; the two-week fact is unchanged.
Placing the directional phrase after the participle is natural Afrikaans in a story; the reordering is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: 'Die bottel het vir 'n toets weggegaan' copies English and makes the bottle the actor.
besluite.rede: 'is vir 'n toets weggestuur' is how Afrikaans says a sample is sent off; same event, no new fact.

besluite.fout: 'teruggestap vir die antwoord' copies English 'went back for the answer'.
besluite.rede: 'om die uitslag te kry' is the natural Afrikaans for collecting a test result and is a word a Grade 5 reader knows; the action is the same.

besluite.fout: 'nadat' with the present-tense 'voel' is slightly off in tense, but it carries the time sense that he must keep going after the point where he feels better.
besluite.rede: Swapping the conjunction to 'wanneer' shifts this medicine instruction from 'after he starts feeling better' to 'at times when he feels well', so the writer must judge whether the tense needs fixing while keeping the 'after' meaning exactly.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: Plain punctuation fix required by AWS 2017.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma, and 'en' blurs the contrast between feeling well and the months of medicine still left.
besluite.rede: 'maar' makes the story's point clearer (feeling well is not the end of the medicine) without adding a fact; the 'maar' in the next sentence is a mild repetition but does not change what either sentence says.
